description:
This beautifully maintained five-bedroom semi-detached home occupies a superb position on the Green Road, Mullingar, within a mature and established residential setting just minutes from the town centre. Presented in excellent condition throughout, the property offers generous accommodation together with a large mature rear garden, making it an ideal choice for families or first-time buyers seeking space in an exceptionally convenient location.

The accommodation opens with a welcoming entrance hall with tiled flooring. The living room features laminate flooring, an inset solid fuel stove and front and rear aspects. The fitted kitchen is finished with tiled flooring and splashbacks and incorporates an integrated oven, electric hob and extractor fan. The generous dining area, which provides excellent additional storage and features a second solid fuel stove with back boiler. A separate utility room offers further fitted storage. A ground floor bedroom, a bright room overlooking the rear garden and a guest WC with an electric shower completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are four further well-proportioned bedrooms. Three are finished with laminate flooring, with fitted storage provided in two, while the particularly spacious fifth bedroom is carpeted. A family shower room and hotpress complete the first floor.

Externally, the property benefits from a large and mature rear garden bordered by established hedging, a garden pond and a block-built storage shed. 

There is also a substantial covered fuel storage area incorporating the boiler and providing access between the front and rear of the property.

The home benefits from oil-fired central heating, with a new boiler installed in 2025, together with the additional benefit of solid fuel heating.

The Green Road offers an exceptionally convenient Mullingar location, with the town centre, train station, primary and secondary schools, Regional Hospital Mullingar and a wide selection of shops and everyday amenities all within easy reach. Early viewing is highly recommended.
